text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with
Mayano
Top Gun...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Remember how I started
live
streaming?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've gotten a lot more viewers
lately. My
channel is super popular
now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking up her archived streams on my
phone, I
see all the evidence I need...

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer A: Maya is such a cutie! Viewer
B: I love
you soooo much, Maya! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passionate comments pop up one after
another.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
See? My popularity is rising way up into
the
atmosphere! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! During my next stream, I wanna
show a
side of myself I've never shown
before!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...But I dunno what I should do. Any
ideas?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I knew you'd come up with
something
good!
choice_data_list: 練習風景を見てもらったら？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I can show everyone just how hard I
work, I'm
sure they'll love me even more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then! ☆ Since it's your idea, I
want you to
help!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I get more viewers, I'll start getting
more
attention during races...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Great! Time to take off toward the
stage! ☆
choice_data_list: わかった。歌っているところを撮ろう！
わかった。走っているところを撮ろう！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna land in everyone's hearts! ☆
Time to
start the show here on Channel
Maya! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer C: Waaaaah! Viewer D: Maya is
as
energetic as ever! ☆ Viewer E: Where
are you
streaming from?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ Thanks for all the comments!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, I thought I'd show you guys how I
really
practice for concerts!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Filming me today is my steadfast
partner, my
trainer! A round of applause,
please!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer helps me train and always
showers me with
praise! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer F: I'm so excited! Viewer G: I
want to be
your trainer! Viewer H: I'm so
jealous!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you guys! ♪ Anyway, time to get
flying!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
One, two! ☆ Sparkle, sparkle! ☆ I!
Am! ☆ A lady!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's end things with a final cute shot of
me!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer I: Sooooo cuuuuute! Viewer J:
Your
dancing and singing are both fire!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, you're not wrong! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Each time I win a race, I'll knock your
socks off
with my winning concert
performance! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So you've gotta give me all your
support!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Great! It's almost time to take off toward
the
track! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna land in everyone's hearts! ☆
Time to
start the show here on Channel
Maya! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer C: Whaaa! Viewer D: You're all
clear for
landing in my heart. ☆ Viewer
E: That outfit tho?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ Thanks for all the comments!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, I thought I'd show you guys how I
train!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Filming me today is my steadfast
partner, my
trainer! A round of applause,
please!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer helps me train and always
showers me with
praise! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer F: Good luck! Viewer G: I'm
rooting for
you, Maya! Viewer H: I
wanna switch places with
your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You guys are too much! Well, time to
train!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Finished! What did you think, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer I: Awesome! Viewer J: You're so
freaking
cool!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, you're not wrong! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm going to show you guys just
how cool I
am!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Be careful not to blink, or you'll totally
miss
me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Maya's motivation through the
roof, she
completes her training session
much more happily
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at how many new viewers
I've got! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So many comments too! I've never
received this
many before!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! ♪ It makes me super happy
seeing you
smile like that! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! I've just got to keep this up
and become
even more popular!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm rewarded, Mayano Top
Gun
becomes even more invested in her
streams.
